Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/getting-started/how-to/declarative/ios

Painpoint: agents frequently need compact, citation-ready context for search/indexing docs agents need: ios

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py context-budget . --json --strict
```

Machine files:
- material-manifest.json
- proof-receipt.json

Rules:
